Job Description EuroChem is one of the leading manufacturers of
fertilizers, with a long-standing presence in Europe and many
countries overseas. With our broad product portfolio, we offer plant
nutrition solutions for every application, including field
fertilization, fertigation, and foliar fertilization. The Supply &
Operations Planning Manager is a central integrator between the
production site and the regional and local Sales organizations. As
part of the regional team in Mannheim, you take full responsibility
for demand planning, supply balancing, and commercial scenario
development for a defined product group and/or a specific production
site in Europe. We are looking for a committed and experienced: Supply
& Operations Planning Manager (m/w/d) Your Key Responsibilities in
detail: Lead S&OP Planning for a Defined Product Portfolio or
Production Site Own the end-to-end S&OP planning cycle for your
assigned products/sites, ensuring a robust, transparent and efficient
planning process while balancing the interdependencies of continuous
fertilizer production, customer service, production stability,
logistics constraints, working capital and financial performance
Integrate commercial priorities into the planning process by
evaluating business opportunities, optimizing contribution margins,
prioritizing markets and ensuring the optimal deployment of
constrained production capacities Facilitate commercial
decision-making in close collaboration with the Commercial Lead
(responsible for the production site or the European commercial
organization) Commercial & Operational Planning Validate demand
forecasts, evaluate commercial opportunities, identify supply gaps or
surpluses and align production capabilities with Sales Managers and
the Commercial Lead Allocation & prioritization: Define & adjust
product allocations and market priorities (planned product volume/
price-positions) in close collaboration with Sales and Supply Chain
Execution to establish delivery commitments and operational priorities
Support working capital optimization by incorporating Order-to-Cash
(OTC) cycle-time considerations into planning decisions using sales
input and historical performance data Inventory, Production & Shipment
Monitoring Tracking regional inventory targets to balance service
levels, production stability and capital efficiency Monitor the
Production–Shipment Plan (actual vs. planned performance), identify
deviations early and initiate necessary corrective actions, such as
accelerated delivery or reallocation of volumes Your Qualification:
Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial
Engineering or comparable field 2 to 5 years professional work
experience in Supply Chain Planning would be an advantage Strong
analytical and commercial thinking skills; ability to balance
trade-offs and drive decisions Structured, proactive and hands-on
approach in dynamic environments Very good communication and
stakeholder management skills High IT affinity; strong Excel skills;
experience with S&OP planning tools is a plus Fluent English (written
and spoken); additional languages are beneficial Enjoy working in a
collaborative, supportive team culture Kontakt Like to work
independently and on your own responsibility? Entrepreneurial thinking
and acting is a matter of course for you? Then we should get to know
each other! Please send your detailed CV in English to Human
Resources, attention Andreas Wagner Andreas.Wagner@eurochem.group

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 8 years of technology related sales, business development, channel sales, or partner management experience.
- Ability to communicate in German and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience building business partnerships with enterprise Independent Software Vendors (ISV).
- Experience selling enterprise software solutions through Cloud Marketplaces.
- Experience working with, and managing, complex sales scenarios with multiple parties with differing goals.
- Experience creating new sales motions to scale best practices.
- Ability to work with customer engineers and customers' technical decision makers to secure a joint opportunity.

About the Job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As an ISV Sales Specialist, you will support the jointGo-To-Market (GTM) success of Independent Software Vendor (ISV) partners, including generating, advancing, and closing co-sell opportunities alongside the Google Cloud field sales team through the Google Cloud Marketplace.  You will work with ISV partners to create region-specific sales motions to increase awareness of the ISV within the Google Cloud field team, generate new leads, and accelerate active opportunities.  You will work with Google Cloud customers to support the evaluation, procurement, and usage of ISV partner solutions.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €114000 - €116000 (EUR) + 66.67% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

- Build and grow relationships with existing ISV partners and customers by closing joint opportunities with Google cloud sales account teams and Google’s ecosystem.
- Develop regional co-sell plans and sales motions for ISV partners, working closely with cross-functional teams, including sales, customer engineers, and services teams.
- Drive sales plan achievement through ISV partner pipeline creation and reviews, ensuring sufficiency in pipeline creation, velocity, and win rate.
- Work with ISV partners, Google Cloud Sales teams, and customers to support transactions through the Google Cloud Marketplace, including distributor and reseller supported transactions.

jobs.description:
At TÜV SÜD Group, we are passionate about technology. Innovations shape our lives in many different ways, and at TÜV SÜD Group, we are highly committed to playing an active role in this progress. We test, we certify, we inspect, and we advise. We challenge ourselves every day to help ensure the safety of people and society. We live technology. We strive for professional excellence. We make an impact. We take the future into our own hands. We are TÜV SÜD Group.

Tasks

- Lead and develop the central PS Division Incident Management team and take over as Head of Incident Management by mid-2027.
- Manage serious incidents, complaints, deviations and claims across the global PS business.
- Develop and coordinate strategies for risk mitigation, claims management and incident prevention.
- Conduct risk assessments and provide risk reporting and recommendations to management.
- Coordinate investigations and collaborate with global operations, Quality Management, Legal, certification bodies, accreditation bodies and authorities.
- Support high-risk projects and drive preventive measures based on incident and risk analysis.
- Protect the TÜV SÜD brand by managing trademark misuse, counterfeiting and related legal actions.
- Coordinate global quality assurance activities, including comparison tests for high-risk products.

Qualifications

- University degree in a technical discipline, engineering, law or a comparable field.
- Strong analytical and comprehension skills, particularly in technical matters.
- Solid legal knowledge, particularly in contract law, trademark law, procedural law, ProdSG and MDR.
- Expert-level knowledge of accreditation and certification, ideally covering consumer, commercial and medical devices.
- Strong risk awareness and ability to assess complex technical, legal and business issues.
- Resilience, perseverance, assertiveness and a hands-on approach.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Excellent written and spoken German and English.
- Additional language skills are an advantage

At TÜV SÜD Group, people from more than 100 nations work together – people with different backgrounds, skills and goals. Our strength lies in these many diverse perspectives.

We are committed to being an inclusive and diverse employer by welcoming everyone. Diversity and inclusion are the foundation of our company, and we foster an environment in which all our employees can trust that they will be treated with respect – regardless of age, nationality, ethnic background, disability, gender and gender identity, sexual orientation, religion or belief.

We expect all our employees to conduct themselves at all times in accordance with the TÜV SÜD Group Code of Ethics and our corporate values.

We firmly believe that consistently embedding these values will continue to make a significant contribution to the success of TÜV SÜD Group.

Conduct strategic discovery, run value leakage, AOTP workshops and deliver persuasive pitches with ways of solving distinct customer business/buying-center challenges to accelerate executive buy-in and drive demand independently of RFPs.

Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with customers and internal stakeholders focused on solution adoption, innovation, risks and opportunities.
- Ecosystem & Partner Engagement: Own relationships with strategic consulting partners (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY) to co-innovate, develop joint go-to-market strategies, and shape disruptive solutions. Maintain direct, high-quality relationships with partner account leads.
- Collaboration & Orchestration: Align closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to ensure SAL impact is fully integrated into the go-to-market engine with tailored GTM approach. Drive joint accountability and coordination across internal stakeholders for maximum market impact.
- Competitive & Industry Expertise: Maintain deep technical and functional knowledge across SAP solutions. Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and competitive trends to craft differentiated solutions that win in the market.

- 
7+ years of professional sales experience, with SAP Spend solutions (Beneficial: Procurement, Sourcing/Contracts, Finance/AP, ERP, Business Technology Platform or Workforce Management), SaaS solutions, VMS or Procurement

- 
Relationships in procurement and finance communities (e.g. CIOs, CPOs, CFOs, procurement/finance directors, Head of Direct or Indirect Proc. etc.) of advantage

- 
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, or related field.

- 
B2B enterprise experience with multi-stakeholder SaaS cycles, plus top-tier consulting and deep industry expertise.

- 
Strong understanding of solution sales, customer value realization, and account planning methodologies; Expansion selling track record (account growth).

- 
Deep SAP and domain expertise, with strong understanding of AI and innovation trends.

- 
Maps value levers and tell a quantified ROI storytelling and compelling business case creation

- 
Strategic thinking, business acumen, relationship building and client advocacy skills.

- 
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.

- 
Ability to work collaboratively in a matrixed environment and influence without direct authority.

- 
Analytical mindset with a focus on problem-solving and continuous improvement.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German (min. C1 level) and English

The SSE is pivotal in shaping SAP’s market leadership by delivering transformative solutions, driving innovation (especially in AI), and orchestrating value across the customer lifecycle. This role is at the intersection of strategy, technology, and relationship management, ensuring customers realize the full value of their SAP investments while positioning the organization for sustained growth.

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

You assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions

- 
You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives

- 
You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools

- 
You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility

- 
You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions

- 
You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices

- 
You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language

- 
You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team members

Qualifikationen

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- 
You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field

- 
You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development

- 
You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)

- 
You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps

- 
You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog

- 
You have a proven track record of implementing cutting-edge technologies within a corporate environment

- 
You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure

- 
You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plus

OUR OFFER TO YOU

·       Modern and dynamic work environment

·       Flexible and mobile working

·       Attractive fitness offer

·       Numerous employee discounts

·       Excellent infrastructure

Zenjob is an AI-powered flexible staffing platform that has efficiently connected companies and temporary workers since 2015. Companies use our platform to book ready-to-work staff in real time, while students use our app to find part-time jobs that conveniently fit around their studies. Over 40,000 students and 1,000 partner companies from logistics, retail, and hospitality in all major German cities share our belief that good work is not a coincidence. It is the result of innovative technology and genuine commitment. Good work starts here.The role
We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Supply engineering team – the team that owns the talent side of our marketplace. Your team of 5-7 engineers builds the experience our Zenjobbers use to discover, book, and get paid for jobs, and the services that keep the supply side of the marketplace healthy.
You'll partner closely with your product counterpart. This is a player-coach role: we're looking for someone who leads through people but stays close enough to the code to guide architecture decisions, unblock the team, and keep the technical bar high.
What you'll do✓
Lead, coach, and grow a cross-functional team of full-stack engineers – owning their development, engagement, and performance✓
Own delivery for the Supply domain: shape the roadmap with your product partner, break down complex initiatives, and ensure the team ships predictably and with quality✓
Engage deeply with the product: question assumptions, challenge proposals, and bring ideas of your own – constructively, and always with the business impact in mind✓
Embrace how AI keeps reshaping engineering as a craft: advocate for the increased autonomy these tools bring, and support your team by role-modelling their usage✓
Stay hands-on: guide system design and architecture decisions, review code where it matters, and contribute when it accelerates the team✓
Drive operational excellence – monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement of the team's engineering practices✓
Hire and onboard engineers as the team evolves, and contribute to engineering-wide initiatives beyond your team✓
Collaborate with other Engineering Managers and stakeholders across Product, Operations, and Marketing to align the supply side of the marketplace with company goals

What you bring✓
Several years of experience leading software engineers as a people manager, ideally in a product-led B2C or marketplace environment✓
A strong technical foundation: you've worked as a senior engineer yourself and can still credibly engage on architecture, code, and technical trade-offs✓
Comfort with our stack: we build in TypeScript across both backend and frontend, with some older services still in Java and Groovy✓
A product mindset: you care about outcomes over output and know how to connect engineering work to user and business impact✓
Experience growing engineers across levels – coaching, feedback, and performance management hold no secrets for you✓
Pragmatism in balancing delivery speed, quality, and maintainability✓
Fluent English (our company language); German is a plus

Engineering at Zenjob
Our product engineering teams are cross-functional and full-stack, each owning one of the business domains our marketplace is built around – Supply, Staffing, and Demand. We build in TypeScript across both backend and frontend, with some older services still in Java and Groovy.
We run a pragmatic engineering culture: outcomes over output, ownership over process, and direct feedback over comfortable silence. Engineers are expected to engage with the product, not just implement it. And we're leaning into how AI is changing the way software gets built – we invest in the tools and expect everyone, managers included, to use them and push what they make possible.

jobs.occupation: Calling Pharmacy Students: Your First Step into Clinical Research - Internship Opportunity (m/f/d) (Pharmazeut/in)
jobs.description:
Job available in 2 locations: Karlsruhe, Munich

Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions
Office

Job Description

Are you a last year university student or recent graduate who would like to take his\her first steps within a dynamic clinical research organization? Are you interested in learning fundamental skills to start effectively your career?

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

How will you make an impact?

The 6 month internship in Clinical Operations is designed to offer you the opportunity to develop insight into clinical research, master your skills while conducting meaningful work within the team. The programme framework is crafted to allow you to grow professionally, learning invaluable skills to help you kick start your career!

What you will do?

As part of the Clinical Operations, you will work closely as a team, providing support and ideas for day to day activities. Your engagement and level of dedication will ensure that our project teams would receive the administrative and technical support they needs. You will have a mentor who will help you navigate through our organization and processes and receive the best support, which will ensure you are on your way to reaching your goals.

You will need to be in the office three days each week, with flexibility to work from home on the other days.
